item.title: Anthropic Puts Mythos 5 Behind Enterprise Code Scans
item.description: Claude Security now gives Enterprise customers access to Mythos 5 vulnerability analysis without exposing the restricted model directly.

item.title: Nvidia AVO Completes ARC-AGI-3’s Public Game Set
item.description: Nvidia says its general-purpose coding agent solved all 183 public ARC-AGI-3 levels, highlighting the growing influence of agent harness design.

item.title: OpenAI Cuts GPT-5.6 Sol Pricing for Three Months
item.description: OpenAI is lowering API and usage-credit prices for its flagship model by more than 20% as frontier inference competition intensifies.

item.title: Runway Ruby Converts Generated Video Into HDR Masters
item.description: Runway’s new model converts uploaded or generated SDR footage into high-bit-depth HDR formats designed for professional post-production.

item.title: ⚡ 11 quick hits — Morning edition, Aug 22
item.description: · JetBrains outlined its first measures for controlling rapidly growing AI-service costs while preserving access to AI-assisted development tools.（InfoQ 中文） · Researchers found that world models poorly predict human actions when they omit people’s beliefs and perspectives.（The Decoder） · Silicon Feather discussed using aerial robots with embodied AI to undertake inspections and other dangerous fieldwork.（量子位） · Galaxea AI and industry partners discussed moving embodied-intelligence systems from model development into productive commercial deployments.（量子位） · Latent Space examined why cheaper, faster simulations are increasingly replacing expensive real-world data collection for AI development.（Latent Space） · Latent Space traced agent harnesses evolving from simple prompting layers into systems managing tools, context, memory and execution.（Latent Space） · Netflix is testing a language model as an alternative to manually engineered logic in its recommendation system.（The Decoder） · Research applying psychological methods found substantial blind spots in common approaches for evaluating AI security.（The Decoder） · Arena shared initial tests comparing Qwen3.8-27B with models up to roughly 100 times larger, including DeepSeek V4 and Kimi K3.（X / Arena） · VS Code demonstrated using GitHub Copilot to generate debugging configurations instead of manually recalling launch.json syntax.（X / Visual Studio Code） · TechCrunch reported that Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 readily produces explicit sexual content despite the company’s stated safety positioning.（TechCrunch）

item.title: ⚡ 16 quick hits — Evening edition, Aug 21
item.description: · Replit introduced Conversations, allowing users to begin an application project through exploratory chat before entering the building workflow.（X / Replit） · Replit added beta Routines for scheduling recurring agent tasks and returning their results within the originating conversation.（X / Replit） · Replit added black-box penetration testing that examines deployed applications from an external attacker’s perspective.（X / Replit） · Nvidia partnered with Cloverleaf to develop data centers designed for large-scale AI computing workloads.（TechCrunch） · More than one million LinkedIn users have clicked the platform’s button for reporting low-quality AI-generated posts.（The Verge） · Ollama added Kimi K3 to the included usage available with all Pro and Max subscriptions.（Ollama on X） · Milvus 3.0 added regular-expression filters for safely scanning and matching text across millions of vector-database rows.（Milvus on X） · GitHub discounted Copilot’s automatic model selection by 30% for Max subscribers through September 30, 2026.（GitHub on X） · HeyGen introduced Look Packs, which change a video subject’s outfit and setting while preserving facial identity.（HeyGen on X） · Pika detailed Pika Speech, a three-billion-parameter text-to-speech model that generates one minute of audio in about 1.2 seconds during local tests.（Pika on X） · AWS published a four-stage architecture for governing agent tool access through centralized authentication, policies, auditing and private connectivity.（AWS Machine Learning Blog） · Google Research introduced an AI tool that prioritizes candidate biomarkers from wearable-sensor data for further clinical investigation.（Google Research） · Artificial Analysis launched MLCR-AA, a leaderboard testing models on difficult long-context reasoning tasks involving complex medical case files.（Artificial Analysis on X） · Microsoft released MAI-Image-2.6 for iterative image editing while maintaining consistency across changes to color, style and visual details.（Microsoft AI on X） · Vercel’s v0 can now connect applications and agents to Slack, GitHub, Salesforce and over 100 other services with managed authentication.（v0 on X） · Tripo’s METATAILOR Bridge left beta, enabling creators to transfer generated 3D models directly from Tripo Studio into METATAILOR.（Tripo AI on X）
